result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues: truncated restaurant names and cut-off cards in horizontal carousels, plus a partially clipped bottom offer card.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you row, and the card is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards have enough width or use ellipsis/wrapping so full names remain readable; avoid clipping the last visible card awkwardly.

issues.description: The bottom popular item card (pizza with -20% badge) is heavily clipped by the bottom navigation, so most of the image and content are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset above the tab bar so full cards can scroll into view without being covered.

issues.description: Category chips row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to cut off an additional chip on the right with no clear fade or affordance.
issues.suggestion: Indicate horizontal scrollability more clearly (fade edge, peek of next chip) or ensure chips fit without abrupt clipping.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under Fastest cards uses inconsistent emphasis and some names/fees may be hard to scan when cards are partially off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Keep card content fully visible in the initial viewport where possible and align text truncation rules consistently across cards.
